proves.claim: tapCaseErrors returns a red case's name with the reporter's # and backslash escapes undone

cli.logic-runner-output.tap-escapes-undo.why: Without it a red case whose name holds # or a backslash never matches the outcomes record and the gate posts failures null.

proves.claim: tapCaseErrors keeps a file-level failure's absolute path unchanged

cli.logic-runner-output.file-path-unchan.why: Without it unescaping could alter the path that names a file-level failure.
